en.t: Dong Zhuo is assassinated by his adopted son Lü Bu
en.s: Dong Zhuo () (c. 140s – 22 May 192), courtesy name Zhongying, was a Chinese military general, politician, and warlord who lived in the late Eastern Han dynasty. At the end of the reign of the Eastern Han, Dong Zhuo was a general and powerful minister of the imperial government.

zh.s: 董卓（字仲颖；约140年代—192年5月22日）是东汉末年的中国将领、政治人物和军阀。东汉末年，他曾任将领和朝廷重臣。

en.s: The Sack of Damietta was a successful raid on the port city of Damietta on the Nile Delta by the Byzantine navy on 22–24 May 853. The city, whose garrison was absent at the time, was sacked and plundered, yielding not only many captives but also large quantities of weapons and supplies intended for the Arab Emirate of Crete.

zh.s: 853年5月22日至24日，拜占庭海军成功袭击尼罗河三角洲港口城市大米特。袭击时城内守军不在，城市遭到劫掠。拜占庭军不仅俘获许多人，还夺得大量武器和补给；这些物资原本准备运往阿拉伯人统治的克里特酋长国。

en.s: The Battle of Aqbat al-Bakr (22 May 1010) was a battle of the Fitna of al-Andalus that took place in the area in and around Espiel, Spain.

zh.s: 阿尔巴克尔山口战役发生于1010年5月22日，是安达卢斯内战中的一场战斗，地点在西班牙埃斯皮埃尔及其周边地区。

en.s: The Treaty of Le Goulet was a treaty signed by Kings John of England and Philip II of France in May 1200. It ended the first succession war following Richard I's death, temporarily settling territorial disputes over Normandy and recognizing John as the rightful heir and King of England. The peace held until Philip's invasion of Normandy in 1202, which led to continental Normandy's formal annexation to the crown lands of France.
en.n: King John of England and King Philip II of France sign the Treaty of Le Goulet.

zh.s: 勒古莱条约于1200年5月由英格兰国王约翰和法国国王腓力二世签署，结束理查一世去世后的第一次继承战争，暂时解决了诺曼底领土争端，并承认约翰是英格兰的合法继承人和国王。双方维持和平至1202年；当年腓力入侵诺曼底，随后法国王室正式兼并诺曼底大陆领土。
zh.n: 英格兰国王约翰和法国国王腓力二世签署勒古莱条约。

en.s: The Brussels massacre was an antisemitic episode in Brussels (then within the Duchy of Brabant) in 1370 in connection with an alleged host desecration at the Brussels synagogue. In May 1370, a number of Jews, variously given as six or about twenty, were executed or otherwise killed, while the rest of the small community was banished. Many Jews from then on migrated further east to both modern day Germany and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

zh.s: 1370年，布鲁塞尔（当时属于布拉班特公国）发生反犹事件，起因是有人指控犹太人在布鲁塞尔犹太会堂亵渎圣体。1370年5月，若干犹太人被处决或以其他方式杀害，人数记载不一，有6人或约20人；其余少数社群成员被驱逐。此后，许多犹太人继续向东迁徙至今德国和波兰—立陶宛联邦地区。

en.s: The First Battle of St Albans, fought on 22 May 1455 at St Albans, 22 miles (35 km) north of London, traditionally marks the beginning of the Wars of the Roses. Richard, Duke of York and his allies, the Neville Earls of Salisbury and Warwick, defeated a royal army commanded by Edmund Beaufort, Duke of Somerset, who was killed.

zh.t: 第一次圣奥尔本斯战役
zh.s: 第一次圣奥尔本斯战役于1455年5月22日在圣奥尔本斯爆发，该地位于伦敦以北22英里（35公里）。这场战役通常被视为玫瑰战争的开端。约克公爵理查及其盟友、内维尔家族的索尔兹伯里伯爵和沃里克伯爵击败了由萨默塞特公爵埃德蒙·博福特指挥的王军，博福特在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Calven (Romansh: Chalavaina) took place on May 22, 1499 at the exit of the Val Müstair in the Grisons (now part of Switzerland) to the Vinschgau in County of Tyrol (now part of Italy) between the forces of king Maximilian I of the House of Habsburg and those of the free federation of the Three Leagues of the Grisons. It was the decisive battle in the southern Grisons of the Swabian War; after the defeat of the Habsburg troops, the king had to abandon his attempts to control the Engadin and the Val Müstair.

zh.s: 卡尔文战役（罗曼什语：Chalavaina）发生于1499年5月22日，地点在格劳宾登的瓦尔米施泰尔山谷出口处，通往蒂罗尔伯国（今意大利）的温施高地区（今瑞士境内）。交战双方是哈布斯堡家族的马克西米利安一世国王军队，以及格劳宾登三同盟自由联盟的军队。这是施瓦本战争中格劳宾登南部的决定性战役。哈布斯堡军队战败后，国王不得不放弃控制恩加丁和瓦尔米施泰尔山谷的企图。

en.t: Massacre in the Great Temple of Tenochtitlan
en.s: The Massacre in the Great Temple, also called the Toxcatl Massacre, or the Alvarado Massacre, was an event on 22 May 1520, in the Mexica, also known as the Aztec, capital of Tenochtitlan during the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire, in which the celebration of the Feast of Toxcatl ended in a massacre of Mexica elites.

zh.t: 特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙大屠杀
zh.s: 大神庙大屠杀又称托斯卡特大屠杀或阿尔瓦拉多大屠杀，发生于1520年5月22日，地点是墨西加人（又称阿兹特克人）的首都特诺奇蒂特兰。当时西班牙人正在征服阿兹特克帝国，托斯卡特节庆祝活动以墨西加贵族遭屠杀告终。

en.s: The Treaty or Peace of Lübeck (Danish: Freden i Lübeck, German: Lübecker Frieden) ended the Danish intervention in the Thirty Years' War (Low Saxon or Emperor's War, Kejserkrigen). It was signed in Lübeck on 22 May 1629 by Albrecht von Wallenstein and Christian IV of Denmark-Norway, and on 7 June by Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor. The Catholic League was formally included as a party.

zh.s: 《吕贝克条约》又称《吕贝克和约》（丹麦语：Freden i Lübeck，德语：Lübecker Frieden），结束了丹麦对三十年战争的干预。这场战争也称下萨克森战争或皇帝战争。1629年5月22日，阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦和丹麦-挪威国王克里斯蒂安四世在吕贝克签署条约；6月7日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世也签署了条约。天主教联盟正式成为条约一方。

en.s: The siege of Besançon took place from 25 April to 22 May 1674 during the Franco-Dutch War, when French forces nominally led by Louis XIV invaded Franche-Comté, then part of the Spanish Empire. Siege works were supervised by the duc d'Enghien, eldest son of le Grand Condé, and French military engineer Sébastien Le Prestre de Vauban. The defenders were commanded by Vaudémont but the town's isolated position meant they could only delay capture.

zh.s: 贝桑松围城战发生于1674年4月25日至5月22日，是法荷战争期间的一场战役。法国军队入侵当时属于西班牙帝国的弗朗什-孔泰地区，名义上由路易十四率领。围城工事由昂吉安公爵（大孔代的长子）和法国军事工程师塞巴斯蒂安·勒普雷斯特·德·沃邦监督。守军由沃德蒙指挥，但贝桑松地处孤立，只能拖延法军攻占城市。

en.t: Battle of Cap de la Roque
en.s: The Battle of Cap de la Roque took place on 22 May 1703 between an Anglo-Dutch convoy protected by a Dutch States Navy squadron under Captain Roemer Vlacq and a larger French Navy squadron under Alain Emmanuel de Coëtlogon during the War of the Spanish Succession. During the war the French and Spanish navies were largely unable to challenge their English and Dutch counterparts in fleet actions and therefore had switched to targeting merchant convoys, forcing the latter to protect them.

zh.s: 罗克角海战发生于1703年5月22日，是西班牙王位继承战争期间的一场海战。罗默·弗拉克上尉率领荷兰海军分舰队护卫一支英荷商船队，阿兰-埃马纽埃尔·德·科埃特洛贡率领规模更大的法国海军分舰队发起攻击。战争期间，法国和西班牙海军很难在舰队会战中挑战英荷海军，于是转而袭击商船队，迫使对方派兵护航。

en.s: The Treaty of Hamburg was signed on 22 May 1762 in Hamburg between Sweden and Prussia during the Pomeranian War, a theater of the Seven Years' War. The treaty came into being after Russia had allied to Prussia on 5 May, making it impossible for Sweden to continue the war which they had entered to regain territories in Pomerania, which they had previously lost.

zh.s: 1762年5月22日，瑞典和普鲁士在汉堡签署《汉堡条约》，结束两国在波美拉尼亚战争中的交战；这场战争是七年战争的一部分。俄罗斯于5月5日与普鲁士结盟后，瑞典已无法继续战争。瑞典参战原是为了收复此前失去的波美拉尼亚领土。

en.t: Trevi Fountain is officially completed and inaugurated in Rome
en.s: The Trevi Fountain (Italian: Fontana di Trevi) is an 18th-century fountain in the Trevi district in Rome, Italy, designed by Italian architect Nicola Salvi and completed by Giuseppe Pannini in 1762. Standing 26.3 metres (86 ft) high and 49.15 metres (161.3 ft) wide, it is the largest Baroque fountain in the world and one of the most famous fountains in the world.

zh.t: 罗马特雷维喷泉正式竣工并举行落成仪式
zh.s: 特雷维喷泉（意大利语：Fontana di Trevi）是位于意大利罗马特雷维区的一座18世纪喷泉，由意大利建筑师尼古拉·萨尔维设计，朱塞佩·潘尼尼于1762年完成。喷泉高26.3米、宽49.15米，是世界上最大的巴洛克式喷泉，也是世界上最著名的喷泉之一。

en.s: The Quito Revolt of 1765, also known as the Rebellion of the Barrios or the Quito Insurrection, was an uprising and insurrection in Quito that temporarily overthrew the colonial Spanish Viceroyalty of New Granada in the city from 1765 until 1766.

zh.s: 1765年基多起义又称巴里奥斯起义或基多叛乱，是基多发生的一场起义。起义于1765年至1766年间一度推翻西班牙新格拉纳达总督区在该城的殖民统治。

en.s: The 1766 Istanbul earthquake was a strong earthquake with epicenter in the eastern part of the Sea of Marmara, in the Çınarcık Basin (or near the Princes' Islands, north of the basin) which occurred in the early hours of Thursday morning, 22 May 1766. The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of 7.1 on the surface-wave magnitude scale, and caused effects in a vast area extending from Izmit to Rodosto (now Tekirdağ).

zh.s: 1766年5月22日星期四凌晨，马尔马拉海东部的恰纳尔哲克海盆或海盆以北的王子群岛附近发生强烈地震。地震震中位于上述海域，估计面波震级为7.1级。地震影响范围很广，从伊兹密特一直延伸到如今名为泰基尔达的罗多斯托。

en.s: The Battle of Tournay or Battle of Tournai or Battle of Pont-à-Chin (22 May 1794) saw Republican French forces led by Jean-Charles Pichegru attack Coalition forces under Emperor Francis II and Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. After a bitter all-day struggle, Coalition troops recaptured a few key positions including Pont-à-Chin, forcing the French to retreat. Pichegru did not maintain effective tactical control during the battle.

zh.s: 图尔奈战役，又称图尔奈之战或蓬阿尚之战，发生于1794年5月22日。让-夏尔·皮什格吕率领的法国共和军进攻由弗朗茨二世皇帝和萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德的约西亚亲王指挥的联军。经过一整天的激战，联军夺回蓬阿尚等几个关键阵地，迫使法军撤退。皮什格吕在战斗中未能有效掌控战术行动。

en.s: The siege of Bastia was a combined British and Corsican military operation during the early stages of the French Revolutionary Wars. The Corsican people had risen up against the French garrison of the island in 1793, and sought support from the British Royal Navy's Mediterranean Fleet under Lord Hood. After initial delays in the autumn, Hood had supplied a small expeditionary force which had successfully driven the French out of the port of San Fiorenzo in February 1794.

zh.s: 巴斯蒂亚围城战是法国大革命战争初期英国与科西嘉联军的一次军事行动。1793年，科西嘉人起义反抗岛上的法国驻军，并寻求英国皇家海军地中海舰队胡德勋爵的支持。秋季行动一度延误后，胡德派出一支小型远征军，于1794年2月成功将法军逐出圣菲奥伦佐港。

en.s: The Battle of the Dardanelles took place on 22 May (10 MayOld Style) 1807 as a part of the Napoleonic Wars during the Russo-Turkish War of 1806–1812. It was fought between the Russian and Ottoman navies near the Dardanelles Strait.

zh.s: 达达尼尔海峡海战发生于1807年5月22日（儒略历5月10日），是拿破仑战争期间俄土战争（1806至1812年）的一部分。交战双方是俄罗斯和奥斯曼帝国海军，战场位于达达尼尔海峡附近。

en.t: On the second and last day of the Battle of Aspern-Essling (near Vienna, Austria), Napoleon I is defeated in a major battle for the first time in his career, and repelled by an enemy army for the first time in a decade
en.s: In the Battle of Aspern–Essling (21–22 May 1809), Napoleon crossed the Danube near Vienna, but the French and their allies were attacked and forced back across the river by the Austrians under Archduke Charles. It was the first time Napoleon had been personally defeated in a major battle, as well as his first battle defeat in 10 years since the siege of Acre, and his first battle defeat as head of state, although he did suffer a tactical defeat in the Battle of Caldiero and in the Second Battle of Bassano.

zh.t: 阿斯佩恩-埃斯林战役第二天：拿破仑一世首次在重大交战中战败
zh.s: 阿斯佩恩-埃斯林战役于1809年5月21日至22日爆发。拿破仑在维也纳附近渡过多瑙河后，法国军队及其盟军遭到卡尔大公率领的奥地利军队攻击，被迫退回河对岸。这是拿破仑首次在重大交战中亲自战败，也是他十年来首次战斗失利（此前最后一次是在阿克里围城战），并且是他作为国家元首首次战败。不过，他此前在卡尔迪耶罗战役和第二次巴萨诺战役中曾遭遇战术失利。

en.s: The Action of 22 May 1811 was a naval engagement between an Algerian fleet commanded by Raïs Hamidou, and a Tunisian one commanded by Mohammed Mourali, also known as al-Mourali.

zh.s: 1811年5月22日，哈米杜·莱斯率领的阿尔及利亚舰队与穆罕默德·穆拉利率领的突尼斯舰队发生海战。穆拉利也称穆拉利。

en.s: The action of 22 May 1812 took place off Groix when a small French squadron comprising the French frigates Ariane and Andromaque, and the brig Mameluck returning from a commerce raiding campaign in the Atlantic, met the 74-gun HMS Northumberland while trying the slip to Lorient through the British blockade. After a gunnery exchange that left all ships damaged, the frigates attempted to lose Northumberland by sailing through a shallow pass, but they ran aground.

zh.s: 1812年5月22日，格鲁瓦岛附近发生海战。一支小型法国分舰队包括“阿里亚娜”号和“安德洛玛克”号护卫舰，以及刚结束大西洋袭击商船行动返回的“马穆鲁克”号双桅船。它们在英国封锁下试图溜入洛里昂时，遇到装备74门火炮的英国皇家海军“诺森伯兰”号。双方交火并造成所有舰船受损后，法国护卫舰试图穿越浅水航道甩开“诺森伯兰”号，结果搁浅。

en.s: The Battle of Reichenbach/Würtzen (German: Schlacht bei Reichenbach und Markersdorf, lit. 'Battle of Reichenbach and Markersdorf') took place on 22 May during the German campaign of 1813 as part of the War of the Sixth Coalition. Coalition forces were pursued after Bautzen and overtaken near Reichenbach. The ensuing battle resulted in a French victory, after Russian and some Prussian forces retreated from Reichenbach to Markersdorf.

zh.s: 赖兴巴赫/维尔岑战役（德语：Schlacht bei Reichenbach und Markersdorf，意为“赖兴巴赫和马尔克斯多夫之战”）发生于1813年5月22日，是第六次反法同盟战争中德国战役的一部分。包岑战役后，联军遭法军追击，并在赖兴巴赫附近被追上。随后法军获胜，俄罗斯军队和部分普鲁士军队从赖兴巴赫撤至马尔克斯多夫。

en.t: It premiered at the Teatro San Benedetto in Venice on 22 May 1813
en.s: L'italiana in Algeri (Italian pronunciation: [litaˈljaːna in alˈdʒɛːri]; The Italian Girl in Algiers) is an operatic dramma giocoso in two acts by Gioachino Rossini to an Italian libretto by Angelo Anelli, based on his earlier text set by Luigi Mosca. It premiered at the Teatro San Benedetto in Venice on 22 May 1813. The music is characteristic of Rossini's style, remarkable for its fusion of sustained, manic energy with elegant, pristine melodies.

zh.t: 《阿尔及尔的意大利女郎》在威尼斯圣贝内代托剧院首演
zh.s: 《阿尔及尔的意大利女郎》（意大利语：L'italiana in Algeri；意大利语发音：[litaˈljaːna in alˈdʒɛːri]）是焦阿基诺·罗西尼创作的两幕喜歌剧，意大利语剧本由安杰洛·阿内利编写，改编自他早先为路易吉·莫斯卡创作的文本。歌剧于1813年5月22日在威尼斯圣贝内代托剧院首演。其音乐体现了罗西尼的风格，将持续而狂放的活力与优雅、纯净的旋律融合在一起。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France between 8 and 22 May 1815 for the period of the Hundred Days. The elections were held to appoint deputies to the Chamber of Representatives established by the Additional Charter of 22 April 1815. The elections were the first since April 1799 and last of the 'republican system' until the Charter of 1830.

zh.s: 法国于1815年5月8日至22日举行立法选举，选出百日王朝时期的议员。选举依据1815年4月22日《附加宪章》，选出众议院议员。这是法国自1799年4月以来首次举行选举，也是1830年宪章确立共和制度前最后一次采用“共和制”的选举。

en.t: The Associated Press is formed in New York City as a non-profit news cooperative
en.s: The Associated Press (AP) is an American not-for-profit news agency headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1846, it operates as a cooperative, unincorporated association, and produces news reports that are distributed to its members, major U.S. daily newspapers and radio and television broadcasters. Since the Pulitzer Prize was established in 1917, the AP has earned 60 of them, including 36 for photography.

zh.t: 美联社在纽约市成立为非营利新闻合作社
zh.s: 美联社（AP）是一家总部位于纽约市的美国非营利新闻机构。它于1846年成立，以合作社形式运营，是一个非法人团体；它制作的新闻报道供其成员、美国主要日报以及广播和电视机构使用。自1917年普利策奖设立以来，美联社共获得60项普利策奖，其中包括36项摄影奖。

en.t: Abraham Lincoln was issued a patent for an invention to lift boats over obstacles in a river, making him the only U.S. president ever to hold a patent
en.s: Abraham Lincoln's patent relates to an invention to buoy and lift boats over shoals and obstructions in a river. Abraham Lincoln conceived the invention when on two occasions the boat on which he traveled got hung up on obstructions. Lincoln's device was composed of large bellows attached to the sides of a boat that were expandable due to air chambers.

en.s: The Quintinshill rail disaster was a multi-train rail crash which occurred on 22 May 1915 outside the Quintinshill signal box near Gretna Green in Dumfriesshire, Scotland. It resulted in the deaths of over 200 people, and is the worst rail disaster in British history. Quintinshill box controlled two passing loops on each side on the Caledonian Main Line linking Glasgow and Carlisle (now part of the West Coast Main Line). At the time of the accident, both passing loops were occupied with goods trains and a northbound local passenger train was standing on the southbound main line.

en.s: The Battle of the Hongorai River took place during the Second World War and involved Australian, New Zealand and Japanese forces. Part of the wider Bougainville Campaign of the Pacific theatre, the battle was fought in the southern sector of Bougainville Island. Coming after the Battle of Slater's Knoll in which a strong Japanese counterattack was defeated, the battle occurred in two distinct periods between 17 April and 22 May 1945, as elements of the Australian 15th Brigade advanced south along the Buin Road.

zh.s: 洪戈莱河战役发生在第二次世界大战期间，交战方包括澳大利亚、新西兰和日本军队。作为太平洋战场布干维尔战役的一部分，战斗发生在布干维尔岛南部。斯莱特山丘战役中，日军强力反击被击退；此后，澳大利亚第15旅沿布因公路向南推进，洪戈莱河战役分为两个阶段，发生于1945年4月17日至5月22日。

en.s: The Battle of Gesher was an attempted joint Iraqi-Jordanian advance against the newly created State of Israel during the 1948 Arab-Israeli War. The battle began on May 14, 1948, when the Jewish exclave of Naharayim was stormed by Arab forces in an attempt to reach the town of Afula and link with the First Yarmouk Brigade of the Arab Liberation Army.

en.s: On 22 May 1960, an earthquake and tsunami occurred in Chile, devastating the city of Valdivia. Most studies have placed it at 9.4–9.6 on the moment magnitude scale, making it the strongest earthquake ever recorded, while some studies have placed the magnitude lower than 9.4. It occurred in the afternoon (19:11:14 UTC, 15:11:14 local time), and lasted 10 minutes.

zh.s: 1960年5月22日，智利发生地震和海啸，瓦尔迪维亚市遭到严重破坏。多数研究估计，这次地震的矩震级为9.4至9.6级，是有记录以来最强的地震；也有研究认为震级低于9.4级。地震发生在下午，即世界协调时间19时11分14秒、当地时间15时11分14秒，持续了10分钟。

en.s: The Sri Lalang by-election was a state assembly by-election that was held on 22 May 1960 in the state of Johor, Malaysia. The Sri Lalang seat fell vacant following the death of its MCA MLA Cheong Soo Kheng which won the seat in 1959 Malayan general election. Ong Kai Beng of Alliance, won the by election, defeating Mohamed Zain Mohamed of Socialist Front with a slim majority of 729 votes.

zh.s: 1960年5月22日，马来西亚柔佛州斯里拉朗举行州议会补选。该席位因马华公会议员张书卿去世而空缺；他曾在1959年马来亚大选中赢得该席位。联盟候选人王开明获胜，以729票的微弱优势击败社会主义阵线候选人穆罕默德·再因·穆罕默德。

en.s: General elections were held in the Belgian Congo on 22 May 1960, in order to create a government to rule the country following independence as the Republic of the Congo (Congo-Léopoldville), scheduled for 30 June. The 137-seat Chamber of Deputies was elected by men over the age of 21. The seats were filled by district-based lists, although only two parties, the Mouvement National Congolais-Lumumba (MNC-L) and the Parti National du Progrès, submitted lists in more than one district.

en.s: Continental Airlines Flight 11, registration N70775, was a Boeing 707 aircraft which exploded in the vicinity of Centerville, Iowa, United States, while en route from O'Hare Airport, Chicago, Illinois, to Kansas City, Missouri, on May 22, 1962. The aircraft crashed in a clover field near Unionville, in Putnam County, Missouri, killing all 45 crew and passengers on board.

en.s: The 1963 European Cup final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 22 May 1963 to determine the winners of the 1962–63 European Cup. en.s: The L'Innovation fire was a fire which took place at the À L'Innovation department store on the Rue Neuve in Brussels, Belgium on 22 May 1967. 323 people were killed, 150 injured and the department store itself, the work of the architect Victor Horta, was destroyed. In the aftermath of the fire, there was speculation that it might have been started by anti-American, Maoist protestors in the context of the Cold War and opposition to United States involvement in the Vietnam War. The Innovation fire was a major tragedy and remains the most deadly fire in Belgian history.

zh.s: 1967年5月22日，L'Innovation百货商店发生火灾。商店位于比利时布鲁塞尔的新街，由建筑师维克多·奥塔设计。火灾造成323人死亡、150人受伤，商店也被焚毁。事后有人猜测，火灾可能由反美的毛派抗议者纵火引起，背景是冷战以及反对美国介入越南战争。L'Innovation火灾是比利时重大灾难，至今仍是该国死亡人数最多的火灾。

en.s: The Sri Lankan Constitution of 1972 was a constitution of Sri Lanka, replaced by the 1978 constitution currently in force. It was Sri Lanka's first republican constitution, and its second since independence in 1948. The constitution changed the country's name from Ceylon to Sri Lanka, and established it as an independent republic. The country was officially designated as the "Republic of Sri Lanka," leading to the constitution being known as the 1972 Republican Constitution. The constitution was promulgated on 22 May 1972.

zh.s: 1972年斯里兰卡宪法是斯里兰卡的宪法，后被现行的1978年宪法取代。这是斯里兰卡首部共和宪法，也是该国1948年独立后的第二部宪法。宪法将国名从锡兰改为斯里兰卡，并确立该国为独立共和国。国家的正式名称定为“斯里兰卡共和国”，因此这部宪法也被称为“1972年共和宪法”。宪法于1972年5月22日颁布。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1979 was held on May 22, 1979 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 31st Parliament of Canada. It resulted in the defeat of the Liberal Party of Canada after 11 years in power under Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau. Joe Clark led the Progressive Conservative Party to power, but with only a minority of seats in the House of Commons. The Liberals, however, did beat the Progressive Conservatives in the overall popular vote by more than 400,000 votes.

zh.s: 1979年5月22日，加拿大举行联邦大选，选出第31届加拿大国会的下议院议员。执政11年的加拿大自由党在总理皮埃尔·特鲁多领导下败选。乔·克拉克领导进步保守党上台，但该党在下议院只取得少数席位。自由党的总得票数仍比进步保守党多出40多万票。

en.s: The 1980 Czechoslovak presidential election was carried out on 22 May 1980 by the deputies of the two houses of the nation's parliament, the Federal Assembly, rather than by popular vote. Gustáv Husák was re-elected for his second term. Husák was the only candidate considered in the joint session, and received a 343 to 0 approval from the 150 member House of the Nations (which consisted of 75 Czech and 75 Slovak deputies) and the 200 member House of the People.

zh.s: 1980年5月22日，捷克斯洛伐克总统选举由联邦议会两院议员投票选出，而非全民投票。古斯塔夫·胡萨克连任，开始第二个任期。他是联席会议上唯一的候选人。在由150名议员组成的民族院（75名捷克议员和75名斯洛伐克议员）和200名议员组成的人民院联席会议上，他以343票赞成、0票反对的结果获通过。

en.s: The 1982 Scottish Cup Final was played on 22 May 1982 at Hampden Park in Glasgow. Aberdeen and Rangers contested the match; the final of the 107th Scottish Cup. zh.s: 1982年苏格兰杯决赛于1982年5月22日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，是第107届苏格兰杯的决赛。阿伯丁队和格拉斯哥流浪者队争夺冠军。阿伯丁在加时赛中凭借麦吉、斯特拉坎和库珀的进球，以4比1获胜。这是十多年来首支赢得该杯赛、但不属于老字号双雄的球队。

en.s: Hashimpura massacre took place on 22 May 1987, during the Hindu-Muslim riots in Meerut city in Uttar Pradesh state, India, when 19 personnel of the Provincial Armed Constabulary (PAC) allegedly rounded up 42 Muslim youth from the Hashimpura mohalla (locality) of the city, took them in truck to the outskirts, near Murad Nagar, in Ghaziabad district, where they were shot and their bodies were dumped in water canals. A few days later dead bodies were found floating in the canals. In May 2000, 16 of the 19 accused surrendered, and were later released on bail, while 3 were already dead.

zh.s: 1987年5月22日，印度北方邦密拉特市发生印度教徒与穆斯林骚乱期间，19名省级武装警察部队（PAC）人员据称在哈希姆普拉街区抓走42名穆斯林青年，用卡车将他们带到市郊，前往加济阿巴德县穆拉德纳加尔附近，并开枪射杀。警察将尸体抛入运河。几天后，人们发现尸体漂浮在水渠中。2000年5月，19名被告中有16人投案，之后获准保释；另外3人当时已经死亡。

en.s: Island council elections were held in the Netherlands Antilles on 10 April (Bonaire and Curaçao) and 22 May 1987 (SSS islands) to elect the members of the island councils of its five island territories. en.s: Yemen, officially the Republic of Yemen, is a country in West Asia. Located in southern Arabia, the country includes the Socotra Archipelago and borders Saudi Arabia to the north, Oman to the northeast, the Arabian Sea to the east, the Gulf of Aden to the south, and the Red Sea to the west. en.s: The 1996 UEFA Champions League final was a football match played on 22 May 1996 between title holders Ajax of the Netherlands and Juventus of Italy. en.s: The Karnataka Legislative Assembly election of 2008 took place in 3 phases on May 10, May 16 and May 22, 2008 in all the 224 assembly constituencies in Karnataka, India. The elections were conducted to elect a Government in the state of Karnataka for the next five years. The votes were counted on May 25, 2008 and due to the use of electronic voting machines, all the results were out by the afternoon itself. en.s: The Crewe and Nantwich by-election, 2008 was a parliamentary by-election held on 22 May 2008, for the British House of Commons constituency of Crewe and Nantwich, in Cheshire, England. The election was won by the Conservative party candidate Edward Timpson, who defeated the Labour party candidate Tamsin Dunwoody, on a swing from Labour to Conservative of 17.6%, a swing that in a general election would see nine Labour cabinet ministers lose their seats. At the time of the by-election, a swing of 7% in a general election would have seen the Conservatives gain an overall majority over Labour.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Dáil Éireann Carlow–Kilkenny constituency in Ireland on 22 May 2015, to fill the vacancy left by the resignation of Fine Gael Teachta Dála (TD) Phil Hogan on his appointment as European Commissioner. It was held on the same day as national referendums on marriage equality and the age of eligibility for election to the office of president. The Electoral (Amendment) Act 2011 stipulates that a by-election in Ireland must be held within six months of a vacancy occurring. The by-election writ was moved in the Dáil on 29 April 2015.

zh.s: 2015年5月22日，爱尔兰达伊尔议会卡洛-基尔肯尼选区举行补选，填补爱尔兰统一党议员菲尔·霍根获任欧盟委员会委员后辞去议席留下的空缺。当天爱尔兰也举行了关于婚姻平权和总统候选人最低年龄的全国公投。2011年《选举修正法》规定，爱尔兰议席空缺后必须在六个月内举行补选。补选令于2015年4月29日在达伊尔议会提出。

en.s: The 2015 Punjab local government elections were held in the Punjab province of Pakistan on 22 May 2015. The elections were won by the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N), which won a majority of seats in the provincial assembly and the district councils.

en.s: The government of Ireland held referendums on 22 May 2015 on two proposed amendments to the Constitution of Ireland which had been recommended by the Constitutional Convention. The amendment to permit same-sex marriage in the Republic of Ireland was approved by 62–38% of the voters. The other amendment would have reduced the age of candidacy for the President of Ireland from 35 to 21, but voters rejected it by 73–27%.

zh.s: 2015年5月22日，爱尔兰政府就两项宪法修正案举行公投。这两项修正案由宪法会议提出。允许爱尔兰共和国同性婚姻的修正案以62%对38%的结果获通过。另一项修正案拟将爱尔兰总统候选人的最低年龄从35岁降至21岁，但选民以73%对27%的结果否决了该提案。

en.s: Extreme Rules (2016) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on May 22, 2016, at the Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey. It was the eighth event under the Extreme Rules chronology. Eight matches were contested at the event, with one being shown on the pre-show. In the main event, Roman Reigns defeated AJ Styles in a Extreme Rules match to retain the WWE World Heavyweight Championship, before Seth Rollins made his return from an injury and attacked Reigns. The event received mixed-to-positive reviews from critics, with praise directed at the Intercontinental Championship four-way and the main event WWE World Heavyweight Championship match.

en.s: The 2016 Swedish Men's Handball Championship final (Swedish: SM-finalen i handboll för herrar 2016) was a handball match that took place at Malmö Arena in Malmö on 22 May 2016 to decide the winner of the 2015–16 Elitserien. zh.t: 2016年瑞典男子手球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2016年瑞典男子手球锦标赛决赛（瑞典语：SM-finalen i handboll för herrar 2016）于2016年5月22日在马尔默的马尔默竞技场举行，决出2015至2016赛季精英联赛冠军。对阵双方是IFK克里斯蒂安斯塔德和阿林索斯HK。克里斯蒂安斯塔德以27比18获胜，连续第二年夺得瑞典冠军。

en.s: The 2nd Justice and Development Party Extraordinary Congress was a party convention of the ruling Justice and Development Party of Turkey held on 22 May 2016. zh.t: 正义与发展党第二次特别大会
zh.s: 土耳其执政党正义与发展党于2016年5月22日举行第二次特别大会。该大会于5月4日宣布举行。此前政界人士和评论员已长期猜测大会将召开，他们注意到总理兼正发党领袖艾哈迈德·达武特奥卢与正发党创始人、前党魁、总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安之间的关系急剧恶化。

en.s: The 2016 Taça de Portugal final was the last match of the 2015–16 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winner of the 76th season of the Taça de Portugal. en.s: The 2016 Albanian Cup final was a football match played on 22 May 2016 to decide the winner of the 2015–16 Albanian Cup, the 64th edition of Albania's primary football cup. zh.s: 2016年阿尔巴尼亚杯决赛于2016年5月22日举行，决出2015至2016赛季、即第64届阿尔巴尼亚主要足球杯赛的冠军。库克斯首次夺冠，在常规时间和加时赛1比1战平后，于点球大战中以5比3获胜。库克斯因此首次赢得阿尔巴尼亚杯；上赛季该队曾被拉奇队击败，错失夺冠机会。

zh.s: 2016年西班牙国王杯决赛于2016年5月22日举行，决出2015至2016赛季冠军。这是自赛事创办以来第114届西班牙顶级足球杯赛决赛，其中包括两个赛季曾同时举行两项相互竞争的赛事。比赛在马德里的维森特·卡尔德隆球场举行。

en.s: On 22 May 2017, twenty-two people were killed and 1,017 injured in an Islamic terrorist suicide bombing at Manchester Arena in Manchester, England. The attack was perpetrated by Islamic extremist Salman Abedi and aided by his brother, Hashem Abedi, at 22:31 following a concert by the American pop singer Ariana Grande. It was the deadliest act of terrorism and the first suicide bombing in the United Kingdom since the 7 July 2005 London bombings.

zh.t: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案
zh.s: 2017年5月22日，英国英格兰曼彻斯特竞技场发生伊斯兰极端主义者自杀式爆炸袭击，造成22人死亡、1,017人受伤。袭击者萨勒曼·阿贝迪在美国流行歌手爱莉安娜·格兰德演唱会结束后，于22时31分实施袭击；其兄弟哈希姆·阿贝迪协助了袭击。这是英国自2005年7月7日伦敦爆炸案以来死亡人数最多的恐怖袭击，也是此后首次自杀式爆炸袭击。

en.s: On 22 May 2021, twenty-one professional runners died from hypothermia while competing in a government-run 100-kilometre (62 mi) trail running ultramarathon race held in the Yellow River Stone Forest in Jingtai County, Gansu, China. The race had 172 participants. When a cold front struck, gusts reaching level 9 (75–88 km/h [47–55 mph]) brought rain and possibly graupel and the apparent temperature dropped from 1 °C (34 °F) at 10:00 to −5 °C (23 °F) from 11:20 to 13:50.

en.s: The 2021 Scottish Cup final was the 136th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 2020–21 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland.
